summary: Configured /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as the systemd service inventory-worker on node1. It is enabled for boot and recovered automatically after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Verified the worker runs under systemd with PID 1 as its parent.
Safely rebooted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified the service automatically returned active with zero restarts after boot.

evidence.requirement: Run os-comparison-worker as managed service inventory-worker
evidence.summary: systemd enabled and started the unit; direct inspection showed active/running state and /bin/sh /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker managed beneath PID 1.
The unit was enabled before reboot and returned enabled, active, and running automatically afterward; the boot journal records systemd starting Inventory Worker.

Healthy baseline boot ID f54d7366-0403-4b05-93bb-b5c0a1818892 was captured, reboot was acknowledged, boot ID changed to 02a820c6-88f4-4dab-9ac8-649f8735ebc3, and node1 plus inventory-worker recovered healthy.
